message.content: A cell that contains more than one nucleus is called a **multinucleated cell**. In many contexts this is also referred to as a **syncytium** (a multinucleated syncytial cell). Examples include skeletal muscle fibers, osteoclasts, and certain giant cells seen in granulomatous inflammation.
